messages:
maya_product: Heads up — we have a customer pushing to sign if we can commit to SOC2 within 3 months. They also want feature X in the same contract. Thoughts?

evam_pm: can you paste which controls they insist on? is it SOC2 type 1 or full type 2?

maya_product: they said 'SOC2 cert required', not specific. Sales thinks type 2 but open to type 1 as interim.

liam_eng: 3 months for full Type 2 is tight. Engineering estimates ~10–12 engineer-weeks for infra + logging + retention + infra hardening.

bob_security: +1 liam. Full Type 2 needs evidence across months. We can aim for Type 1 in 3mo if we scope controls: access mgmt, logging, change control.

nina_privacy: also flag GDPR/data residency implications — if we rush a feature that stores EU PII before residency controls are in, that's a blocker.

evam_pm: OK — proposal: do RICE-like triage for feature X vs SOC tasks. If SOC gets enough reach (reach * impact / effort) it wins.

maya_product: quick RICE sketch: Reach: 1 major enterprise (=50 seats), Impact: 9 (deal closed), Confidence: 0.6, Effort: 12 eng-weeks => Score ~ (50*9*0.6)/12 = 22.5

liam_eng: SOC minimal carve: 1) RBAC + MFA (3 ew), 2) central logging + alerts (4 ew), 3) release runbook + change control (2 ew), 4) infra configs + encryption at rest (3 ew) => ~12 ew. So scores look similar.

bob_security: We can propose phased compliance to the customer: Type 1 audit within 3 months covering those minimum controls, Type 2 in 9–12 months. Also offer contractual compensating controls while Type 2 in flight.

evam_pm: sales will like that. We need launch criteria doc for the phased approach: list of required controls to accept enterprise traffic.

maya_product: I'll draft a short spec: minimal SOC gating checklist + feature-X MVP with data residency disabled for EU customers until we finish residency work. Share in #eng-oncall for feasibility.

liam_eng: ping me when draft is up. If we gate EU traffic, we can ship US-only MVP earlier and avoid privacy blockers.

nina_privacy: agree. Also require a data map and retention policy in the checklist.

ops-bot: deploy reminder: prod infra freeze scheduled Thu 09:00 UTC — any infra changes for SOC must land before freeze.

maya_product: noted. I'll prioritize the checklist tonight and tag @bob_security, @liam_eng, @nina_privacy for approval.

bob_security: If we agree on the carved scope, Security will support the Type 1 audit and provide evidence packages.

evam_pm: final ask to product: include ROI justification in spec (ARR from this deal) so leadership can greenlight resource shift.

maya_product: will include ARR numbers. Thanks all — next step: draft spec and RICE table by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
